sentences.text: CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE HARKESH MANUJA
Present: Mr. Shailendra Jain, Senior Advocate, assisted by  Mr. Munish Kumar, Advocate and  Ms. Navneet Kaur, Advocate  for the applicants-appellant  appellants / landowners.

Mr. Shivendra Swaroop,, Deputy Advocate General, Haryana  ****
HARKESH MANUJA, J.

The appellants-landowners,, by instituting the present appeal preferred under Section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (for short "the Act"), are seeking modification of the award dated 13.05.2013 .2013 passed by learned Additional District Judge, Gurgaon Court"), while praying for (hereinafter to be referred as "Reference Court") enhancement of compensation amount.

[2] Briefly, the facts are that in pursuance of Haryana Govt. Notification under Section 4 of the Act issued on 15.11.2002, followed by Notification dated 12.11.2003 under Section 6 thereof, the land measuring 110 bighas, 9 biswas, 18-  biswansi, situated within the revenue estate of Village Khandsa; 69 acres, 4 kanals, 4 marlas land Village Narsinghpur; and 157 acres, 1 kanal, 16.62 marlas land of 1 of 4 Neutral Citation No:=2024:PHHC:086964 CM No. 1551-CI of 2024 in/and Village Begumpur Khatola, including the land of appellants, was acquired.

sentences.text:
The public purpose for acquisition of the land was stated to be development of integrated complex for Industrial, Instiutional, Commercial, Re-Creational and other Public Utilities for IMT Manesar,
Tehsil and District Gurgaon.

The Land Acquisition Collector, Gurgaon (for short "LAC"), vide Award No. 2, dated 18.11.2005, assessed the market value of the acquired land @ ` 15,00,000/- per acre for all the three villages alongwith other statutory benefits.

[3] Dissatisfied with the aforesaid Award,
landowners / interested persons, including the appellants, filed objections under Section 18 of the Act, which were decided vide award dated 13.05.2013 by Reference Court, whereby the market value of the acquired land was enhanced / assessed @ ` 40,95,000/- per acre irrespective of the nature of land, besides granting statutory benefits.
[4] Aggrieved thereof, the appellants-landowners preferred the present appeal, which stood admitted vide order dated 08.10.2015 passed by this Court.

[5] Now, by way of application bearing CM No. 1551-CI of 2024 moved on behalf of the applicants-appellants / landowners, prayer has been made for disposal of the main appeal in terms of judgment dated 23.09.2014 passed by this Court in RFA-5378-2013, titled "Ram Niwas and others Versus Sub Divisional Officer and others".

entities.text: Ram Niwas and others Versus Sub Divisional Officer and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
[6] Learned Senior Counsel for the applicants-appellants submits that other similarly situated landowners approached this Court 2 of 4 Neutral Citation No:=2024:PHHC:086964 CM No. 1551-CI of 2024 in/and by filing appeals for enhancement of compensation, pertaining to the acquired land of Village Khandsa under the same notification, which were allowed vide decision dated 23.09.2014 in a bunch of appeals, lead case of which was Ram Niwas and others' case (supra), thereby awarding compensation @ `57,08,000/-
per acre alongwith statutory benefits, while the cross-appeals filed at the instance of HSIIDC were dismissed.

entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: Learned Senior Counsel contends that the present appeal is squarely covered with the judgment of Ram Niwas and others' case (supra), arising out of the same notification vide which the land of applicants-appellants had been acquired.
[7] Notice of the aforesaid application.

[8] Mr. Shivendra Swaroop, Deputy Advocate General,
Haryana, accepts notice and does not dispute the afore-stated factual position about judgment dated 23.09.2014 passed in Ram Niwas and others' case (supra); but opposes the payment of interest for the period, the applicants-appellants failed to approach this Court after the decision of Reference Court.
[9] I have heard learned counsel for the parties and gone through the paper-book.
[10] From the records, it is apparent that the present appeal is squarely covered with the judgment of Ram Niwas and others' case (supra), which is arising out of the same acquisition / Notification dated 15.11.2002 covering the same revenue estate i.e. Village Khandsa, whereby the landowners have been held entitled for the enhanced amount of compensation @ ` 57,08,000/- per acre.

For reference, the relevant para from judgment dated 23.09.2014 passed in case of Ram Niwas and others (supra) (at page No. 3) reads as under:-
Chandgi Ram vs State Of Haryana And Ors on 10 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/54025386/
2 3 of 4 Neutral Citation No:=2024:PHHC:086964 CM No. 1551-CI of 2024 in/and "
For the aforesaid acquisition, this Court vide judgment in RFA No. 2174 of 2012 Smt.
Savitri Devi vs The Land Acquisition Collector, Gurgaon and others, decided on 23.9.2014, had assessed the compensation of land of village Khandsa @ `
57,08,000/- per acre.

sentences.text: The landowners herein shall be entitled to same compensation.
They shall also be entitled to all the benefits available to them under the Act.
The impugned award of the learned Court below is modified to the extent mentioned above.
Accordingly, the appeals filed by the HSIIDC are dismissed and that of the landowners are allowed.

" 
[10.1] Based upon the above, applying the principle of parity, besides award of just and fair compensation, the landowners / appellants being similarly situated are held entitled for grant of similar amount of compensation as has been awarded to other landowners vide judgment dated 23.09.2014 in case of Ram Niwas and others (supra), alongwith all other statutory benefits and interest thereupon as provided under the Act, except interest for the period the applicants-appellants did not approach this Court beyond 90 days after passing of Reference Court's Award.
[11] In view of the above discussion, present application is allowed; with the consent of learned counsel for the parties, the main appeal is taken on board today itself and disposed off in the above terms.
[12] Pending miscellaneous application(s), if any, shall also stand disposed off.
July 10, 2024 ( HARKESH MANUJA )
